packageRules.description: libs.versions.toml pins the MINIMUM supported versions (compileOnly floors of the support matrix) and libs.example.legacy.versions.toml is the frozen javax stack; both are maintained manually.

vertx-jdbc-client4 is the pinned 4.x line (hibernate-reactive-javax example); update only within 4.x. The current vertx-jdbc-client 5.x line stays unrestricted, so a new major still surfaces as a proposal.
p6spy for the Boot 3 examples is pinned to the 1.x line; the current Boot 4 line (2.x) stays unrestricted.
spring-batch-test for the Batch 5 examples is pinned to the 5.x line; the current Batch 6 line stays unrestricted.
Boot 3 example stack: pinned to the 3.x line; the starters and the plugin share the spring-boot3 [versions] entry, so they are grouped into one PR that bumps the shared version ref.

Boot 4 example stack: NOT version-restricted (a new major is a migration signal), but grouped because the starters and the plugin share the spring-boot4 [versions] entry and must be bumped together in one PR.
